collection.title: Volvo XC60 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Volvo XC60 from 2017 Onwards is fitted with a new type of wiper blade called the 'AquaBlade'. This unique type of wiper, developed by Valeo, delivers wiper fluid directly onto the windscreen through the wiper blade. The drivers side requires a 26" AquaBlade and a 19" for the passengers side. They are available in both heated and unheated varients but these are not inter-changeable, so replacment must be the same version as originally fitted to your XC60. We also have rear blades for this model, please click on the Rear Blades tab.
